summary: Build menu costing, HACCP, inventory, and service control skills in 5 days. Enrol in practical food and beverage management training.
lede: Food and beverage management combines outlet planning with control of menus, costs, stock, service and hygiene. Designed for professionals managing or supporting restaurant, hotel, catering and other food-service operations, this training addresses day-to-day decisions about outlet performance, guest experience and food safety controls. Participants practise recipe costing and menu analysis, inventory and waste monitoring, labour planning, service recovery, and interpreting POS reports and demand forecasts.
audienceIntro: This food and beverage management training is designed for professionals who already manage or support daily operations and need sharper control over cost, service, and compliance.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites for this advanced course include operational experience in a restaurant, hotel, catering, or multi-outlet food and beverage environment; working knowledge of service workflows, purchasing, and basic cost control; and familiarity with POS reports, inventory sheets, or standard operating procedures. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and interpreting operational data. Advanced topics such as AI-supported forecasting and dashboard design are taught at an operational application level, not as technical engineering.
